module Tests.Draw where

import DA.Assert
import Daml.Script

import Types
import Chess
import Init

import Tests.Chess

testThreeRepeat = script do
  InitData {..} <- initData

  submitMustFail white do
    exerciseCmd game ClaimDraw

  let
    moves = [
      (white, A2, A4),
      (black, A7, A5),
      -- (1) Move the A column rooks forward and back.
      (white, A1, A3),
      (black, A8, A6),
      (white, A3, A1),
      (black, A6, A8),
      -- (2)
      (white, A1, A3),
      (black, A8, A6),
      (white, A3, A1),
      (black, A6, A8),
      -- (3)
      (white, A1, A3),
      (black, A8, A6),
      (white, A3, A1),
      (black, A6, A8)
      ]
  game <- foldl takeMove (return $ Right game) moves

  draw <- case game of
    Right g -> do
      submit white do
        exerciseCmd g ClaimDraw
    Left _ -> abort "Should be in play"

  Some res <- queryContractId white draw
  res.winner === None

  assert True

testFiftyMove = script do
  InitData {..} <- initData

  submitMustFail white do
    exerciseCmd game ClaimDraw

  let
    moves = [
      (white, A2, A4),
      (black, A7, A5)
      ] ++
      (join (replicate 11 [
        (white, A1, A3),
        (black, A8, A6),
        (white, A3, A1),
        (black, A6, A8)
      ])) ++
      [
        (white, A1, A3),
        (black, A8, A6),
        (white, A3, B3)
      ]
  game <- foldl takeMove (return $ Right game) moves

  case game of
    Right g -> do
      submitMustFail white do
        exerciseCmd g ClaimDraw
    Left _ -> abort "Should be in play"

  game <- takeMove (return game) (black, A6, A8)


  draw <- case game of
    Right g -> do
      submit white do
        exerciseCmd g ClaimDraw
    Left _ -> abort "Should be in play"

  Some res <- queryContractId white draw
  res.winner === None

  assert True

module Tests.Draw where

import DA.Assert
import DA.List as L
import Daml.Script

import Types
import Rules.Data
import Rules.Draw
import Rules.Main

chessMove : Coord -> Coord -> ChessMove
chessMove from to = ChessMove with
  from
  to
  promote = None
  check = None

play : [(Coord, Coord)] -> [ChessMove]
play pairs = reverse (map (\(from, to) -> chessMove from to) pairs)

knightCycle : [(Coord, Coord)]
knightCycle = [(G1, F3), (G8, F6), (F3, G1), (F6, G8)]

initialDrawState : DrawState
initialDrawState = DrawState with
  idleMoves = 0
  stateCounts = [(toOrd (initState ()), 1)]
  gameState = initState ()

step : DrawState -> ChessMove -> Script DrawState
step state next = case moveFn next (Right state) of
  Left errorMessage -> abort errorMessage
  Right result -> return result

testInitialPosition = script do
  checkDraw [] === Right False
  checkDraw (play knightCycle) === Right False
  checkDraw (play (knightCycle ++ knightCycle)) === Right False
  checkDraw (play (knightCycle ++ knightCycle ++ knightCycle)) === Right True

testRepetitionAfterPawnMoves = script do
  let newPosition = knightCycle ++ knightCycle ++ [(A2, A3), (A7, A6)]
  checkDraw (play (newPosition ++ knightCycle)) === Right False
  checkDraw (play (newPosition ++ knightCycle ++ knightCycle)) === Right True

testRepetitionIncludesPlayerAndMovedFlags = script do
  let start = initState ()
  toOrd start === toOrd (start with moves = [chessMove G1 F3], everCheck = (True, True))
  assert (toOrd start /= toOrd (start with player = Black))
  toOrd start === toOrd (start with pieces = reverse start.pieces)
  case start.pieces of
    [] -> abort "Starting position must contain pieces"
    first :: rest -> do
      assert (toOrd start /= toOrd (start with pieces = (first with coord = A3) :: rest))
      assert (toOrd start /= toOrd (start with pieces = (first with tp = Queen) :: rest))
      assert (toOrd start /= toOrd (start with pieces = (first with owner = Black) :: rest))
      assert (toOrd start /= toOrd (start with pieces = (first with moved = True) :: rest))
  let afterWhite = tryMoveInner start (chessMove G1 F3)
  case afterWhite of
    Left message -> abort message
    Right state -> do
      case tryMoveInner state (chessMove G8 F6) of
        Left message -> abort message
        Right nextState -> case tryMoveInner nextState (chessMove F3 G1) of
          Left message -> abort message
          Right finalState -> assert (toOrd start /= toOrd finalState)

testStateCounts = script do
  increment 4 ([] : [(Int, Int)]) === [(4, 1)]
  increment 4 [(3, 2), (4, 2), (5, 1)] === [(4, 3), (3, 2), (5, 1)]
  increment 6 [(3, 2), (4, 2)] === [(6, 1), (3, 2), (4, 2)]
  first <- step initialDrawState (chessMove G1 F3)
  first.idleMoves === 1
  first.stateCounts === [(toOrd first.gameState, 1), (toOrd initialDrawState.gameState, 1)]
  second <- step first (chessMove G8 F6)
  second.idleMoves === 2
  assert (toOrd second.gameState /= toOrd first.gameState)

testPawnResetsIdleMoves = script do
  let nearLimit = initialDrawState with idleMoves = 49
  whitePawn <- step nearLimit (chessMove E2 E4)
  whitePawn.idleMoves === 0
  blackKnight <- step (whitePawn with idleMoves = 49) (chessMove G8 F6)
  blackKnight.idleMoves === 50
  whiteKnight <- step (blackKnight with idleMoves = 49) (chessMove G1 F3)
  whiteKnight.idleMoves === 50
  blackPawn <- step (whiteKnight with idleMoves = 49) (chessMove D7 D5)
  blackPawn.idleMoves === 0

testCapturesResetIdleMoves = script do
  white <- step initialDrawState (chessMove E2 E4)
  black <- step white (chessMove D7 D5)
  capture <- step (black with idleMoves = 49) (chessMove E4 D5)
  capture.idleMoves === 0
  whiteKnight <- step initialDrawState (chessMove G1 F3)
  blackKnight <- step whiteKnight (chessMove B8 C6)
  whitePawn <- step blackKnight (chessMove E2 E4)
  blackPawn <- step whitePawn (chessMove E7 E5)
  knightCapture <- step (blackPawn with idleMoves = 49) (chessMove F3 E5)
  knightCapture.idleMoves === 0

testEnPassantResetsIdleMoves = script do
  white <- step initialDrawState (chessMove B2 B4)
  black <- step white (chessMove E7 E6)
  advanced <- step black (chessMove B4 B5)
  adjacent <- step advanced (chessMove C7 C5)
  captured <- step (adjacent with idleMoves = 49) (chessMove B5 C6)
  captured.idleMoves === 0

longQuietGame : [(Coord, Coord)]
longQuietGame =
  [ (G1, F3), (B8, A6)
  , (F3, H4), (G8, H6)
  , (H4, F3), (H6, F5)
  , (B1, C3), (F5, D6)
  , (C3, B1), (A6, C5)
  , (B1, A3), (D6, C4)
  , (F3, H4), (C5, B3)
  , (A3, B1), (C4, A5)
  , (B1, A3), (B3, C5)
  , (H4, G6), (C5, D3)
  , (A3, B5), (D3, F4)
  , (G6, E5), (F4, D3)
  , (E5, F3), (A5, C6)
  , (F3, G1), (C6, B4)
  , (B5, A3), (B4, D5)
  , (A3, C4), (D5, B4)
  , (C4, B6), (D3, E5)
  , (B6, C4), (B4, D3)
  , (C4, A5), (E5, G4)
  , (A5, C4), (G4, E3)
  , (C4, A3), (E3, F5)
  , (A3, B5), (D3, B4)
  , (B5, D6), (B4, D5)
  , (D6, B5), (F5, D6)
  , (B5, D4), (D5, F4)
  ]

testFiftyQuietMoves = script do
  checkDraw (play (L.take 49 longQuietGame)) === Right False
  checkDraw (play longQuietGame) === Right True
  checkDraw (play (L.take 49 longQuietGame ++ [(A7, A6)])) === Right False

testIllegalMovesAreRejected = script do
  checkDraw [chessMove A3 A4] === Left "From position not occupied"
  checkDraw [chessMove G8 F6] === Left "Player doesn't own piece"
  checkDraw [chessMove A1 A2] === Left "Can't capture own piece"
  checkDraw [chessMove C1 H6] === Left "Path blocked"
  checkDraw (play [(G1, F3), (G1, F3)]) === Left "From position not occupied"
